verdict: Yes. Kalakaram pitched creative DIY kits for all ages on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal from three sharks, with strong revenue. DIY kits sell to kids, adults looking for a hobby and companies for team activities.
angle: Craft kits such as Madhubani painting, embroidery, pottery and resin art turn a craft into a weekend activity. Corporate workshops and gifting add large orders. Kits are light and easy to ship, and good instructions are the product.
